records.mechanism: D18 makes A project unquestionable expertise by confidently recategorizing contrary evidence and outside assistance as parts of A's method.
records.confusableConcept: Merciful lying would protect B from hurt; A's explanations instead preserve A's apparent technical authority.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A5 accepts B4's engineer while instructing B to report A's invented diagnostic progress, preserving the expert performance through help.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a incorporates professional assistance into A's supposed process; alternative b redefines physical mistakes as specialist tests.
records.reason: Retained unchanged: B's constructive offer changes the tactic, and A develops the same game by claiming authorship of the handoff.
records.reservation: The boiler's literal 'help' display is a comic premise; the scene works through character confidence rather than realistic diagnostics.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims a specialist tuning method; A3 and A5 confidently make obvious signs of incompetence sound intentional.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's untouched strings prompt A3's preliminary wood explanation, and B4's backward instrument prompts A5's orientation test.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 scrutinize the treatment of B's own violin, with increasingly concrete reasons to question A.

heightening.evidence: B4 reveals an elementary handling error, and A5 claims an even more specialized procedure to absorb it.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes tuning B's violin; B2 and B4 give actors clear physical facts entirely through dialogue.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'We don't rush the wood' is economical; A5's longer technical phrase has a clear purpose as an authority shield.

records.mechanism: D18 makes A maintain expert authority by explaining mistakes as deliberate stages of an inaccessible specialist procedure.

records.alternativeComparison: The boiler scene permits a helpful handoff without surrendering authority; the violin scene keeps control by reclassifying errors in front of the owner.
records.reason: Retained unchanged: both technical inventions respond to specific observations, and B's second observation makes the authority claim harder to sustain.
records.reservation: A1's 'structural optimism' reveals the bluff immediately to the audience; sincere delivery is essential to avoid a knowingly absurd performance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 supplies pizza and therefore deal-finding in A3; B4 rejects competition and therefore becomes the subject of A5's judged argument.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from competing over dinner to judging whether B can escape competition, increasing A's control.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I'll judge' efficiently reveals how A intends to control the outcome of B4's objection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We disagree about dinner. First to peel five potatoes chooses.

records.confusableConcept: General competitiveness might seek one victory; this A repeatedly turns B's attempted alternatives into new competitions.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A3 absorbs B2's compromise into deal-finding, and A5 absorbs B4's refusal into a contest with A as judge.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asserts superiority, A3 invents a new basis after B2 disproves it, and A5 proposes racing after B4 dismisses the comparison.

specificity.evidence: A1 and B2 establish two cups from one teapot, giving A3 a specific factual obstacle.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's decisive pouring is a compact invented distinction; A5 is brief but does not clearly declare how A expects to win.

records.mechanism: D19 makes A transform an ordinary difference into a contest, then change the event when B explains the difference practically.

records.reason: Revised to give B a practical objective and A a visible winning intention. Second internal pass on the five spoken A1–A5 turns: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4; total 90. B4's train deadline causes the switch to finishing speed in A5.

records.reservation: A5's liberation is more abstract than the car scene's wet feet; sincere optimism must carry the financial reversal.
